audience: retailers who run stores and tills on Lightspeed Retail (X-Series)

useCases.title: Check sales totals and the till's payment totals
useCases.text: The AI reads sale count, net, tax and gross totals for a period, by outlet and payment type, and the payment totals of a register since it opened.

useCases.title: Find a sale by date, customer or invoice number
useCases.text: The AI searches sales by date range, state, outlet, register, user, customer, payment type, product or invoice number and opens one with its lines and payments.

useCases.title: Check stock on hand and reorder levels
useCases.text: The AI finds products by SKU, brand, supplier or tag and reads stock on hand per outlet with reorder threshold and amount, so you see what to reorder.

useCases.title: Track supplier stock orders and transfers
useCases.text: The AI lists stock orders, outlet transfers, stocktakes and returns by status and reads the product lines of one with ordered and received quantities.

useCases.title: Look up, add or update a customer
useCases.text: The AI searches customers by email, name, phone or code and reads balance and spend. It can create a new customer or change fields of an existing one.

useCases.title: Change a product's price, stock count or reorder level
useCases.text: The AI reads a product and its stock first, then sets the selling price, or the stock on hand and the reorder point and amount of one product at one outlet.
